prompt:
Bold clean ink linework, flat vibrant cell-shaded colors, rounded expressive character designs, distinctive 1980s Akira Toriyama manga aesthetic. Create ONE finished landscape 1536x1024 comic panel, NOT a character sheet. Alien game world BROWN EMPTY ROCKY PLAIN and uniform overcast grey sky. NO visible sun, NO buildings, NO laboratory. 
SCENE: 주희의 표정이 변한다. 미소가 사라진다. 처음으로 진지한 얼굴 — 닥터슬럼프풍 과장이 걷히고, 리얼리스틱한 표정이 드러난다. 눈가에 주름. 입술이 일자로 닫힌다.
Visible named cast: 주희. Character sheets are identity references ONLY; never copy their backgrounds. Wang Miao always wears pale blue-grey shirt and dark trousers. All lettering and exact digits will be added later: NO readable text, numbers, symbols, balloons, captions or watermark in generated artwork. Clean coherent anatomy, strong ink composition, no extra characters or alien creatures. Non-graphic disaster where described.
